measurements.note: Revision 1.0 of this sheet prints 265 C as the glass transition. No polyamide has one: revision 2.0 of the same sheet prints 125 C as the glass transition and 265 C as the melting temperature, which is what 265 is. The number is kept as printed and backs no headline, estimate or bound. Corrected against the source: the sheet names the method for this row and the record did not: "DSC Tg", which its thermal table prints where another table prints a standard. Corrected against the source: Specimen / print parameters holds what p. 1 prints under "Printed Specimen Conditions", the conditions its test specimens were printed under (D63), which took out of the product's print profile.
